prompt: Which plan for a Hart Room notice follows the instructions?
promptZh: 哈特室的公告採用哪項做法才符合指示？

options.text: A noticeboard post advertising pocket-card pickup through Saturday only
options.zh: 在公告欄刊登口袋卡領取只到週六
options.whyZh: 領取桌和人員只確認到週六，且完整展覽未確認，故在公告欄僅宣傳到週六的口袋卡領取。公告標題使用「僅提供口袋卡」。

options.text: A noticeboard post advertising pocket-card pickup on both Saturday and Sunday
options.zh: 在公告欄刊登週六、週日都可領取口袋卡
options.whyZh: 公告欄是合適管道，但哈特室平常週日開放，不代表領取服務當天有人負責。

options.text: A city calendar entry advertising pocket-card pickup through Saturday only
options.zh: 在市府活動行事曆刊登口袋卡領取只到週六
options.whyZh: 週六是正確的領取期限，但市府活動行事曆不刊登只有口袋卡的領取活動。

options.text: A city calendar entry announcing a full-show stop through Saturday
options.zh: 在市府活動行事曆預告完整展覽將在哈特室展出至週六
options.whyZh: 市府活動行事曆用於完整展覽，但哈特室需要的平放抽屜尚未確認，不能宣布完整展覽會在這裡舉行。

explanationZh: 領取桌和人員只確認到週六，且完整展覽未確認，故在公告欄僅宣傳到週六的口袋卡領取。公告標題使用「僅提供口袋卡」。

vocabulary.zh: 已確認有人值班的期間
vocabulary.note: 場館平常開放，並不等於指定領取服務已安排好人員。

evidence: The route kit contains raised maps that visitors can follow under a guide’s direction. Mount the maps on a portable floor stand (not on a countertop) unless the venue has a fixed mount. After a session, the maps must go into a flat, lockable drawer. A spare stand travels with every kit; storage does not. / Hart Room: The lobby table and staffing for pocket-card pickup are confirmed through Saturday. Staff are still checking whether there is a flat drawer for the raised route maps. / The city calendar is for full-show listings, and a venue has to confirm all required equipment before we give it a listing. Use our noticeboard for a confirmed card pickup when the show is not confirmed; use ‘pocket cards only’ as the heading. Hart Room normally opens on Sundays, but do not advertise pickup for any day beyond the confirmed staffing period.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The route kit contains raised maps that visitors can follow under a guide’s direction. Mount the maps on a portable floor stand (not on a countertop) unless the venue has a fixed mount. After a session, the maps must go into a flat, lockable drawer. A spare stand travels with every kit; storage does not.
Hart Room: The lobby table and staffing for pocket-card pickup are confirmed through Saturday. Staff are still checking whether there is a flat drawer for the raised route maps.

The city calendar is for full-show listings, and a venue has to confirm all required equipment before we give it a listing. Use our noticeboard for a confirmed card pickup when the show is not confirmed; use ‘pocket cards only’ as the heading. Hart Room normally opens on Sundays, but do not advertise pickup for any day beyond the confirmed staffing period.
